faq.title: Questions about SalonGo pricing
faq.q1: Do I need a card for the trial?
faq.a1: No. New salons get {days} days with every feature. When the trial ends, your data stays.
faq.a2: No. Pay monthly or yearly. A card plan can stop renewing at any time and stays active until the end of the paid period.
faq.a3: On the web: click Renew plan, sign in, pick a plan and pay. The app updates right away. The iPhone app doesn't sell plans.
faq.q4: Do I lose data when the plan expires?
faq.a4: No. The app reminds you 2 days before. After expiry some features are locked until you renew; checkout and invoices keep working.
faq.a5: Yes, on the Renew page. An upgrade starts right away, a downgrade starts with the next period.
faq.q6: Is there a limit on clients or appointments?
faq.a6: No. Clients, appointments and invoices are unlimited. Plans limit staff, locations and how many clients get your marketing email each day (none on Basic, 50 on Pro, unlimited on Premium).
faq.q7: Can one owner run several locations?
faq.a7: Yes. One owner account runs every location. Each location has its own plan and end date.
faq.a8: No. EET 2.0 is in every plan, including Chair.
faq.q9: I rent a chair in a salon and have my own IČO. Which plan?
faq.a9: The Chair plan, {priceDesk} CZK/month: checkout, receipts and EET with your own certificate, no calendar. Need appointments? Switch to Basic at any time.
faq.q10: I'm employed by a salon. Do I need a plan?
faq.a10: No. The owner adds you as staff in the salon's account.
